facts.title: Peanut Butter Honey Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 cans coconut milk (28 ounces total), either 2 cans full-fat or 1 can full-fat and 1 can light
½ cup creamy, natural, unsalted* peanut butter
1 ½ teaspoons arrowroot starch (optional), whisked with a few tablespoons of the coconut milk mixture
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
